description: This file defines an Android Activity demonstrating the use of Intent flags to modify activity stack behavior, including creating custom back stacks with Intents, handling button clicks, and utilizing PendingIntents.

classes.name: IntentActivityFlags
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating intent flags and PendingIntent utilization to manipulate activity stacks in an app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and binds button click listeners.

methods.name: buildIntentsToViewsLists
methods.description: Builds an array of Intents representing a back stack for navigation within the app.

methods.name: mFlagActivityClearTaskListener (OnClickListener)
methods.description: Handles button click to start activities with a custom back stack.

methods.name: mFlagActivityClearTaskPIListener (OnClickListener)
methods.description: Handles button click to create and send a PendingIntent with a custom back stack.
